mode_note: Wynk has no web-search tool, so NATIVE_SEARCH is not applicable: every system reads the same frozen pages of each held-out task.
task_prompt_example:
Per the Veldkamp Instruments fact sheet: which city is the headquarters, and in what year was the company founded?

Use the available tools to read the source pages for this task (list_pages, read_page). Answer using only information stated in those pages.

Answer fields (use these JSON types):
- hq (string, required)
- founded (integer, required)

Final answer: return ONLY a JSON object of this form:
{"answer": {<field>: <value>, ...}, "evidence": {<field>: [{"page_id": <page id>, "quote": <exact text copied from that page>}, ...], ...}}
Give at least one evidence entry per answer field (several when a value combines several places on a page). Each quote must be copied verbatim from the page so it can be located.
